cases.summary_en: The Catholic argument from marital exclusivity remains in the wider public marriage/fidelity questions. Original clinical or social-science material describing consensual non-monogamy does not establish that mutual consent changes the objective definition of Catholic matrimonial exclusivity. This archive-only dossier must not be promoted as a detailed practice catalogue.
